A curated selection of software, services, and utilities that I find exceptionally useful, use in my daily workflows, and warmly recommend.

## Coding, Terminal & Environments

::: {.tool-list}
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://positron.posit.co/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Positron</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Next-generation data science IDE by Posit; combines VS Code extensibility with first-class interactive R and Python data exploration.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Desktop</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://wezfurlong.org/wezterm/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">WezTerm</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and multiplexer in Rust; fast, cross-platform, and cleanly configurable via Lua.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Desktop</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://quarto.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Quarto</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Open-source scientific publishing system for reproducible papers, slides, books, and websites (powers this site).</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">CLI</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://bun.sh/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">bun</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">All-in-one JavaScript runtime, bundler, and package manager that replaces slow Node tooling with near-instant execution.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">CLI</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">uv</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Rust-based Python package and environment manager; orders of magnitude faster and far cleaner than pip/conda.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">CLI</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://yazi-rs.github.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">yazi</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Blazing-fast terminal file manager in Rust with async I/O, inline image previews, and effortless Vim-like navigation.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">CLI</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://github.com/Graphixa/FontGet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">fontget</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Cross-platform CLI for searching and installing fonts directly from the terminal without hunting through websites.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">CLI</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://fedoraproject.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Fedora</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Polished, up-to-date Linux distribution that balances modern packages with rock-solid stability for daily work.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Linux OS</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://github.com/coatless-rpkg/livelink" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">livelink</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">R package that turns local R scripts and Shiny apps into shareable URLs running directly in the browser via webR.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">R</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">llama.cpp</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Lightweight C/C++ inference engine for running open-weight LLMs locally with minimal overhead and full privacy.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Desktop</span>
</div>
:::

## Data, Web & File Conversion

::: {.tool-list}
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://www.tadviewer.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Tad</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">DuckDB-powered desktop viewer for inspecting and pivoting huge CSV and Parquet files that choke spreadsheet apps.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Desktop</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://smoothcsv.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SmoothCSV</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Fast, responsive desktop CSV editor built specifically for cleanly viewing and editing large delimited tables.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Desktop</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://ziptbl.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ziptable</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Shares small CSV/JSON datasets as a single URL compressed directly in the link fragment—no server or account needed.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Web</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://vert.sh/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Vert.sh</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Private, ad-free in-browser file converter powered by WebAssembly; converts files locally without uploading them.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Web</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://yhsure.github.io/qr-dancer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">qr-dancer</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Turns pixel art into functional, locally verified custom QR codes—great for distinctive slides and handouts.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Web</span>
</div>
<div class="tool-row">
  <div class="tool-name"><a href="https://www.star-history.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Star-history</a></div>
  <div class="tool-desc">Simple, clean way to plot and compare GitHub repository star growth over time when evaluating open-source tools.</div>
  <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border tool-badge">Web</span>
</div>
:::

## Files, Backups & Security

::: {.tool-list}
<div class="tool-row">
